notes: v6.3.1 - Correction release for the 9:16 template, from the first real clips. Template captions are rebuilt: they arrived as whole sentences, one big block of text at landscape size. Clip transcription now takes Whisper's per-word timestamps and builds captions as short word-timed events, so they land word by word in step with the speech, following your chosen caption style (Bold Pop, Karaoke and the rest), and template clips import them at a size scaled for the vertical canvas - clearly smaller, never a full-sentence block. The facecam panel is a third bigger. Template renders get a light colour grade (gentle contrast + saturation lift) and a slow push-in across the clip, on top of the existing punch-in and opening flash. The YouTube sign-in error line now matches the method you actually use: with a cookies.txt file it says the export is probably stale and how to export a fresh one, instead of wrongly telling you to close Chrome. Setup is now one-time for real: SETUP.bat offers Firefox first (recommended) - sign in once and Aura reads the live sign-in fresh every run, so it never goes stale; Firefox is installed via winget (the standard Mozilla build) if missing, the setup probes the sign-in before declaring success, and if a Microsoft Store Firefox hides its profile where tools cannot read it, both the setup and the panel say so in plain words with the cures. The panel also defaults to Firefox by itself when a Firefox profile exists and no method was ever chosen. Everything else is exactly v6.3. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
